identities.description: Poloidal neutral-state momentum flux is the transport-surface-normal flux density of poloidal linear momentum carried by neutral particles in a specified atomic, molecular, charge, or excitation state. In flux-surface coordinates (ρ, θ, φ), the transported momentum is along increasing θ and the flux direction is the positive normal to a constant-ρ surface.
